hooks.command: m="$HOME/.sumo-agents/bin/mem"; [ -x "$m" ] || { echo "sumo-agents is not set up on this machine — run: node bin/mem.mjs setup"; exit 0; }; "$m" hook session-start --harness claude || echo "sumo-agents: the memory launcher failed, so nothing is being remembered — run: node bin/mem.mjs setup"
m="$HOME/.sumo-agents/bin/mem"; [ -x "$m" ] || exit 0; "$m" hook prompt --harness claude || true
m="$HOME/.sumo-agents/bin/mem"; [ -x "$m" ] || exit 0; "$m" hook pre-tool --harness claude || true
m="$HOME/.sumo-agents/bin/mem"; [ -x "$m" ] || exit 0; "$m" hook stop --harness claude || true
m="$HOME/.sumo-agents/bin/mem"; [ -x "$m" ] || exit 0; "$m" hook session-end --harness claude || true
